Property Description

Experience comfortable urban living in this beautifully furnished 1-bedroom apartment, thoughtfully designed to offer both style and functionality. Spanning 925.05 sq. ft., this spacious residence features a bright open-plan layout that maximizes natural light while creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

The living and dining area is tastefully furnished, providing the perfect space to relax, entertain guests, or work from home. The modern kitchen is well-equipped with quality cabinetry, ample storage, and essential appliances, making everyday living effortless. The generously sized bedroom offers a peaceful retreat with built-in wardrobes, while the contemporary bathroom is finished with high-quality fittings and a sleek design.

Whether you are looking for a comfortable home or a smart investment opportunity, this fully furnished apartment is ready for immediate occupancy. Its spacious layout, elegant interiors, and practical design make it an excellent choice for professionals, couples, or investors seeking a property that combines convenience with modern living.

Residents can enjoy access to a range of premium lifestyle amenities, creating a balanced and enjoyable living experience in a well-maintained community.
